warnings: Heights are printed from ระดับพื้นห้อง. ป2/ป3/ป4/น3/น4 print two widths — the outer (frame) width is width_m, the inner one leaf_width_m. น1/น2 print sill 0.85 + window 1.20 = 2.05; น4 prints 1.65 + 0.40 = 2.15; น3 prints 1.10 high with its head at 2.05 (sill not printed separately).
panel_note values are counted from the drawn elevations (sash panels and sliding arrows), not printed text.
count is the printed จำนวน.
